mutations.label: test-order: a file that failed in the last run runs first
mutations.only: ^(?:a failed file runs first, an unmeasured one next, and the rest longest first)$

mutations.label: test-order: the rest run longest first
mutations.only: ^(?:a failed file runs first, an unmeasured one next, and the rest longest first)$

mutations.label: test-order: a file the times do not name runs before the measured ones
mutations.only: ^(?:a failed file runs first, an unmeasured one next, and the rest longest first)$

mutations.label: test-order: a file whose row counted no tests is unmeasured
mutations.only: ^(?:a file whose row counted no tests of its own is unmeasured, not the shortest)$

mutations.label: test-order: a 0-test file that failed still runs first
mutations.only: ^(?:a file whose row counted no tests of its own is unmeasured, not the shortest)$

mutations.label: test-order: it says when it printed the order given
mutations.only: ^(?:the script reorders real paths by their names inside the root, and keeps the order given with no times|the gate runs its files in that order, and in glob order when it cannot)$
